section.content: 本发明的目标是减缓半导体集成电路中的电压降的增加。半导体集成电路包括多个第I/O单元、多个第二I/O单元以及电势供应单元。多个第I/O单元被排列在半导体集成电路基板上。多个第二I/O单元沿着多个第I/O单元被排列在半导体集成电路基板上。电势供应单元被形成在半导体封装基板上，电势供应单元的部分在半导体封装基板的表面中突出，并且经由包括突出部分的区域将预定电势供应给作为多个第I/O单元中的任个的主单元以及多个第二I/O单元中的邻近主单元的单元。

It is an object of the present invention to slow down the increase of the voltage drop in semiconductor integrated circuit.Semiconductor integrated circuit includes multiple first I/O units, multiple 2nd I/O units and potential feeding unit.Multiple first I/O units are arranged on semiconductor integrated circuit substrates.Multiple 2nd I/O units are arranged on semiconductor integrated circuit substrates along multiple first I/O units.Potential feeding unit is formed on conductor package substrate, a part for potential feeding unit is prominent in the surface of conductor package substrate, and predetermined potential is supplied to the unit as the master unit of any one in multiple first I/O units and the neighbouring master unit in multiple 2nd I/O units via the region including ledge.

Semiconductor integrated circuitTechnical field

This technology is related to semiconductor integrated circuit.More specifically, this technology is related to reception and output signal and electricity The semiconductor integrated circuit of the I/O unit in source.

Background technology

In recent years, the demand to smaller and lighter electronic installation be present.For example, in order to reduce the big of electronic installation It is small, have attempted to increase the integrated level for the semiconductor integrated circuit that electronic installation includes.Semiconductor integrated circuit it is higher Integrated level along with input to semiconductor integrated circuit and from semiconductor integrated circuit output signal or electric power number The increase of amount.Therefore, semiconductor packages is used to effectively distribute these signals or electric power.

Semiconductor chip is arranged on the substrate of semiconductor packages, and power ring, ground loop, lead frame etc. are set Put around semiconductor chip.Semiconductor chip includes being used to receive and multiple input/output (I/ of out-put supply or signal O) unit, its arrangement of periphery along semiconductor chip.Here, I/O units be divided into for supply the power unit of electric power with And for receiving the signal element with output signal.Power unit is connected to power ring or ground loop by distribution, believes simultaneously Number unit is connected to lead frame by distribution.

As for the mode of arrangement I/O units, it has been proposed that wherein at least set two row I/O units and power unit quilt The semiconductor integrated circuit of the first row is arranged on, wherein, line direction is along the direction on the periphery of semiconductor chip and first Row is closer to the row (for example, with reference to patent document 1) on periphery.Because if power unit is arranged on further from partly leading In second row on the periphery of body chip, then due to by installing with wire bonding, causing to be difficult to provide in the same column of the first row Signal element.Specifically, if signal element is arranged in the same column of the first row, distribution and the company of power unit are connected to Being connected to the distribution of signal element can cross one another.Therefore, power unit is typically provided in the first row.

However, in above-mentioned conventional art, it may be difficult to reduce the increase of voltage drop.The value of voltage drop is by flowing through interconnection Electric current I and the resistance R product of interconnection calculate, and therefore, voltage drop is also referred to as IR pressure drops.Because IR pressure drops increase, The voltage for the circuit block being supplied in semiconductor integrated circuit is likely lower than or equal to operating voltage, so as to cause failure.

In above-mentioned semiconductor integrated circuit, power unit is arranged in the first row.Therefore, if power interconnection is from partly Power unit in conductor chip is connected to circuit block, then must arrange power interconnection so that power interconnection passes through in the second row I/O units between gap.Accordingly, it is difficult to increase the width of power interconnection, IR pressure drops increase may be caused.

In order to increase the width of power interconnection, there is the electric power list of same potential with the potential of the power unit in the first row Member may be disposed in the same column of the second row.However, in the configuration, the quantity increase of the power unit in each row, and And therefore, larger space is needed with wire bonding in power ring and ground loop.Therefore, it is necessary to increase power ring or ground connection The width of ring.Therefore, the size of semiconductor integrated circuit may increase.Therefore, when reducing the size of semiconductor integrated circuit It is difficult to the increase for reducing IR pressure drops.

In view of these situations, it has been proposed that this technology.The target of this technology is reduced in semiconductor integrated circuit The increase of voltage drop.

According to this technology, the increased good result of the voltage drop that can be reduced in semiconductor integrated circuit can be shown.
